مُقْمِرٌ : see أَقْمَرُ. ―
-b2- إِنَّ اللَّيْلَ طَوِيلٌ وَأَنْتَ مُقْمِرٌ [Verily the night is long, and thou hast the light of the moon: a proverb:] meaning, Wait thou patiently for the accomplishment of thy want. (JK.) [See Freytag's Arab. Prov., i. 45.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
